methodology.protocol: Exact prior14 rows, same plateau/search windows, channel projections, fine-grid minima/ties and strip thresholds. No new fit, registration, window selection or tuning.
methodology.scope: Saved .25 REST/HELD single-slider evidence only. Not Dock, panel, range or dynamics acceptance.
methodology.failed_first_arm: narrow-dispersion-optics remains excluded because its shader binding missed uniform-size registration and fell back. This supplement uses only valid r2.
methodology.limits: Native outline is not fitted; source raster phase retained. Upper rows overlap conservative title exclusion; cap extrema can include contour/material. Existing scenes are diagnostic, not a new independent holdout.

audit.input_limit: Compose injection and held state, not a separate raw Android platform receipt trace.
audit.apk_limit: APK/source receipts must be joined separately if supplied; do not hash an overwritten current host APK as an older variant.

calibration_verbatim.purpose: Optical material sampling alignment only; excludes native/product geometry acceptance.
calibration_verbatim.policy: Derive one fixture-only translation from the first raw REST visual center; each axis must be within1dp or abort. Reuse it unchanged across backgrounds, themes, HELD and post-CANCEL REST. Never retune by theme, value or state; never move or stretch the backing world.

source.geometry_source: actual attached LayoutCoordinates.localToScreen at all four layout corners and local unit basis

glass_background_host.geometry_source: actual attached LayoutCoordinates.localToScreen at all four layout corners and local unit basis

background_world.outside_world: opaque neutral #F0F0F5 recorded in the same GlassBackground

raw_geometry.geometry_source: Actual attached LayoutCoordinates map all four corners and unit basis through the production transform; semantic boundsInRoot are recorded separately. Visual carrier bounds exclude shadow and are not an alpha-mask or a claim of native geometry parity. Six dp around the carrier, union the whole touch holder, is retained as capture/readiness room.

audit.source_receipt_limit: Saved capture hashes and geometry/input checks; no fresh device or reproducible source-to-binary claim.
